test_title: PYST 25: SSC CHSL - Reasoning (Held On: 3 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: If 25 March 1995 is a Saturday, then what will be the day of the week on 12 December 1997?
solution:
We have, 25 March 1995 is Saturday.

Since 1996 is leap year = 2 odd days. So, 25 March 1996 = Saturday + 2 = Monday

Again 1997 is ordinary year = 1 odd day. So 25 March 1997 = Monday +1 = Tuesday

Next, we will count the remaining days = 6 + 30 + 31 + 30 + 31 + 31 + 30 + 31 + 30 + 12 = 262 ÷ 7 = 3 odd days

Thus, on 12 Dec 1997 = Tuesday + 3 = Friday

Hence, the correct answer is **"Friday".**
